description: NWS alert history (last 7 days) — Every National Weather Service watch, warning and advisory issued in the last 1-7 days for a US point (lat/lon or place) or a whole state: updates and cancellations folded into each alert, counts by event type with max severity, active-now and severe/extreme counts, and the 25 most recent alerts with onset, end, headline and area. Optional event filter (e.g. flood, tornado). Use weather/alerts for what is in effect right now. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_alerts_history
